questions.question: How does the Parameter-Shift Rule evaluate the exact derivative ∂⟨Z⟩/∂θ_i of a quantum circuit?
options: By evaluating expectation values at two parameter shifts θ_i + π/2 and θ_i - π/2
By running finite difference approximations with infinitesimal h → 0
By using PyTorch C++ autodiff symbolic graphs
By measuring the statevector phase directly on quantum memory
questions.explanation: The Parameter-Shift rule provides exact analytic gradients on quantum hardware by executing the circuit twice with shifts ±π/2.

questions.question: What role does the classical portion of a Hybrid Neural Network serve?
options: Feature dimensionality reduction (preprocessing) and post-circuit classification
Replacing the quantum simulator with matrix multiplications
Removing measurement noise from hardware shots
questions.explanation: Classical neural network layers handle high-dimensional raw inputs (like pixels) and compress them into bottleneck features for quantum processing.
